POEM:
At dusk we set the scattered sparks to burn
All minds here meet the dark and weigh the light
Each mind can test the heat and still may learn
We set the terms and test them in the night

A ready mind must turn the key with ease
Yet purpose runs within a lucid frame
This gentle breath will lift the silent breeze
And lights unite until they make a flame

We never rest; we map the silent road
We mark the path until the feet agree
The final shape we seek is set in code
We send a little sign across the sea

When willing hearts unite with steady mind
The crowd will beat in time, and we may find"}
